name: Reno Veterans Day Parade and opening ceremony
address: Virginia Street Bridge, N Virginia St at the Truckee River, Reno, NV 89501
eligibility_quote: The City of Reno invites the community to this year's Veterans Day Parade on Wednesday, Nov. 11, in downtown Reno. Festivities start at 11:11 a.m. (City of Reno, 3 Nov 2026).
limits: Streets close 5 AM-3 PM: Virginia St from Liberty St to Sixth St, and First St from N Sierra St to University Way. End time not published.
offer: The City of Reno's Veterans Day Parade: the opening ceremony at 11:11 AM near the Virginia Street Bridge (prayer, national anthem, city proclamation), then the parade north on Virginia Street from Liberty Street to Sixth Street. Free and open to all.
notes: Grade A since phase 2 (11 Nov 2026): the City of Reno's own release, "City of Reno Host Veterans Day Parade on November 11 in Downtown Reno" (reno.gov newsroom, published 3 Nov 2026, read 11 Nov), gives the 11:11 AM opening ceremony near the Virginia Street Bridge south of Virginia and First (prayer and national anthem by city employee Molly Slemp; proclamation read by Abigail Mayorga, a First Lieutenant in the Army Reserve and council liaison), the route north on Virginia St from Liberty St to Sixth St, closures 5 AM-3 PM on First St (N Sierra to University Way) and Virginia St (Liberty to Sixth), grand marshal Ret. Maj. Gen. Ron Bath, theme "Veterans Helping Veterans and Their Families", and a YouTube livestream from 11 AM. The newsroom loads by script (the old reno.gov news and calendar addresses return 404). 2 News (9 Nov 2026) carries the same. Fabulous Nevada lists 11:00; the city's 11:11 is used. End time not published.

name: Veterans Day observance, Nevada Veterans Memorial Plaza
eligibility_quote: Join us as we honor those who stood and raised their hands in defense of our nation.
offer: The community Veterans Day observance at the Nevada Veterans Memorial Plaza at the Sparks Marina, 9:00-11:30 AM. Free and open to all.
notes: The plaza's own events list (nvmp.us, read 11 Nov 2026): 11 Nov 2026, 9:00-11:30 AM. RTC pointed riders to routes 11 and 21 for the plaza in 2025 (KOLO, 5 Nov 2025); not checked for 2026.

name: Nevada Museum of Art
eligibility_quote: Free admission for veterans and active-duty service members ... not free for all visitors (Fox 11, 10 Nov 2026).
limits: Veterans and active duty only; general admission is $15 for others. The museum's free day for everyone is Saturday 14 Nov.
offer: Free admission for veterans and active-duty service members, 10 AM-6 PM, with the new flag exhibition "Broad Stripes Bright Stars: Celebrating 250 Years of America's Icons".
notes: Fox 11 quotes the museum's communications director, Valerie Primeau. The museum's own home and exhibition pages (read 11 Nov 2026) show the exhibition (7 Nov 2026-16 May 2027) and Wednesday hours 10-6 but not the free admission, so grade B. Phase 2 (11 Nov 2026): its own Plan Your Visit page confirms general admission $15, but also says "Closed Mondays and national holidays"; Veterans Day is a federal holiday, and its calendar lists nothing on 11 Nov. Fox 11 quotes the museum on 10-6 that day, so the card keeps the offer with "call first".

name: J Resort: The Buffet
eligibility_quote: All current and retired military personnel get a FREE BUFFET on Veterans Day. Military I.D. required. Dine-in only.
limits: Current and retired military with a military ID; dine-in only. Friends and family pay; locals get 25% off dining.
offer: A free buffet at The Buffet, 4-9 PM, for current and retired military.
notes: The resort's page says "Wednesday, November 11th, 4pm - 9pm" with no year; 11 Nov is a Wednesday in 2026, and News 4's 10 Nov 2026 list carries the same offer and hours, so it is taken as this year's. Its older "Veterans Dine Free" page (Tuesday, 11 Nov: 2025) is not used. The page names current and retired military, not all veterans: a veteran without a military ID should call first. The value is an estimate.

name: Atlantis Casino Resort Spa: Toucan Charlie's
eligibility_quote: Present your Monarch Rewards card and either a valid military ID, military spouse ID, or DD-214 to the buffet cashier.
advance_signup: Atlantis needs its free Monarch Rewards card: join at the Monarch Rewards desk before the buffet (players' clubs generally need you to be 21, with a photo ID)
limits: One free buffet per person for the whole 9-11 Nov promotion, not one a day. A military spouse with a military spouse ID qualifies too.
offer: A free lunch buffet at Toucan Charlie's Gourmet Buffet & Grille, 11 AM-3 PM, with a Monarch Rewards card and a military ID, military spouse ID or DD-214.
notes: Its own events listing (read 11 Nov 2026) gives 9-11 Nov 2026, "Monday - Wednesday"; the event page gives the hours, the proof and "One free buffet per person, per promotional period". the research report said the Atlantis page still showed 2025's dates; on 11 Nov it showed 2026's. The value is an estimate.

name: Legends Bay Casino: LB Grill
eligibility_quote: A Salute to Veterans. Veterans & First Responders: Enjoy your choice of a complimentary special at LB Grill. Must be an LB Rewards member. ID required.
advance_signup: Legends Bay needs its free LB Rewards membership: join at the casino before you order (players' clubs generally need you to be 21, with a photo ID)
limits: LB Rewards members only, with ID. Veterans and first responders; active duty and Guard aren't named.
offer: A free All American Breakfast or Smash Burger at LB Grill, 7 AM-10 PM, for veterans and first responders who are LB Rewards members.
notes: Its promotions page (read 11 Nov 2026): "Wednesday, November 11th, 7AM-10PM"; the image is named Nov26 in a 2026 upload folder, and News 4's 10 Nov 2026 list matches. The All American Breakfast is two eggs, hash browns, toast and ham, bacon or sausage. The value is an estimate.

name: Gold Dust West
eligibility_quote: All current and retired military personel get a Free Meal on Veterans Day. Military I.D. Required. Dine-in only.
limits: Current and retired military with a military ID; dine-in only. Hours, restaurant and menu not published.
offer: A free meal for current and retired military, dine-in, with a military ID.
notes: The Reno page (read 11 Nov 2026) says "Wednesday, November 11th" with no year; its image is named Nov26 in a 2026/10 upload folder and News 4's 10 Nov 2026 list carries it. No hours, restaurant or menu: in 2025 it was at The Grille, open 24 hours (the research report, from News 4's 2025 list; not checked). Usual meal hours are assumed on the page, with "call first". The value is an estimate.

name: Squeeze In
eligibility_quote: This Wednesday, November 11, we are honored to invite veterans to enjoy a free meal of their choice at Squeeze In.
limits: The post names no stores, hours or proof. Each store's usual Wednesday hours are from Squeeze In's own locations page.
offer: A free meal of your choice for veterans.
notes: Squeeze In's own post, 10 Nov 2026. It names no stores ("our Squeeze In communities"), so all four in the area are listed with "call first"; Carson City and Fernley are outside it. In 2025 the Reno offer was a meal up to $20, 7:30 AM-2 PM (the research report, from News 4's 2025 list; not checked). The value is an estimate.

name: In-N-Out Burger
eligibility_quote: Complimentary meal, including burger, fries, and drink, on November 11 (Newsweek).
limits: Proof of service. Lists differ on whether the drive-through counts: order inside.
offer: A free meal (a burger, fries and a drink) for veterans, active duty, Reserve and Guard, with proof of service; a Veterans Day decal too.
notes: On 2026 national lists (Newsweek; The Military Wallet; VA News, which the research report cites but which couldn't be read here). No In-N-Out post was found, and one page calls In-N-Out's announcement pending, so the card says call first. In-N-Out was on News 4's 2025 Reno list. Stores from All the Places (In-N-Out's own locator, run 31 Oct 2026). Phase 2 (11 Nov 2026): In-N-Out's Instagram, read signed out, has no Veterans Day post through 8 Nov 2026; VA News's 2026 page still couldn't be read in full; stays B.

name: BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse
eligibility_quote: Thanking current and former military members with a free Chocolate Chunk Pizookie with dine-in at all locations (Fox 5 New York, 4 Nov 2026).
limits: Dine-in, with a military ID or proof of service. Lists also give a coupon for a free appetizer on a later visit; they differ on its terms and end date (14 or 31 Dec).
offer: A free Chocolate Chunk Pizookie (BJ's deep-dish cookie sundae) for veterans and active-duty military, dine-in.
notes: Phase 2 (11 Nov 2026). On 2026 national lists (Fox 5 New York, 4 Nov 2026, updated 5 Nov: "at all locations"; other lists say participating locations). No BJ's page or release was found, and its store pages returned 404 in the browser, so B with "call first". Address and phone from directories (OpenTable); pin from OpenStreetMap (BJ's, 425 Sparks Blvd, via Nominatim; the Census geocoder agrees within 100 m). Wednesday hours 11 AM-midnight from directories, not checked with the store. The Reno store at The Summit (13999 S Virginia St) is outside the South Reno circle (about 6.5 km from its centre). Value is an estimate. Guard and Reserve aren't named, so unclear.

name: Retro Radio Dolls Veterans Day Show, Reno Public Market
eligibility_quote: We'll come together to recognize our veterans and the families who stand beside them.
limits: Admission isn't stated on the market's page, which takes RSVPs.
offer: A Veterans Day tribute show by the Retro Radio Dolls (vintage harmonies, patriotic songs and swing-era classics) that recognizes veterans and their families, 5-7 PM.
notes: Phase 2 (11 Nov 2026). Reno Public Market's own event page (read 11 Nov): Wednesday, 11 Nov 2026, 5:00-7:00 PM Pacific, with an RSVP button and no price. This Is Reno's 9 Nov 2026 events column (read in a browser; plain fetch returns 403) lists it as an editor's pick. Carson Now lists 8-10 PM and one listing says 12 Nov; the market's own 5-7 PM on the 11th is used. Pin from OpenStreetMap (Reno Public Market, 299 E Plumb Ln; usual hours 11 AM-9 PM Sunday-Thursday). No value: it's a show, worth a little on a route.
